challenging the order dated 27th August, 2024 passed in respect of F.Y. 2019-20 by the office of Sales Tax Officer Class II/ AVATO, Delhi.

events.quote: The Show Cause Notice was issued to the Petitioner on 20th May, 2024.
On 13th June, 2024, the Petitioner filed a reply seeking time till 30th June, 2024 to file certain documents.
A reminder notice was also issued by the Department on 25th June, 2024.
Thereafter, the impugned order was passed on 27th August, 2024.

defects_argued.quote: The validity of the impugned notification was under consideration before this Court in a batch of petitions with the lead petition being W.P.(C) 16499/2023 titled ‘DJST Traders Pvt. Ltd. vs. Union of India and Ors.’.

In the present case, Ms. Kavita Jha, ld. Sr. Counsel for the Petitioner submits that the opportunity to file a reply was not availed of by the Petitioner who had in fact sought an adjournment before the Adjudicating Authority.

outcome.quote: Accordingly, the present writ petition is disposed of in above terms.
